analysis: paired basal-q25, apical-q25 and combined q25 layout contrasts

interaction_definition.interpretation: Descriptive paired numerical contrasts only. They do not establish causality, biological interaction or population-level generalization.

limits: Four individual morphology reconstructions are not a population sample.
The analysis inherits the passive linear-RC and declared numerical-protocol limits of the primary experiment.
Ratios are shown with absolute deltas because near-zero baseline residuals can make ratios unstable.
The multiplicative interaction ratio is a log-error-scale descriptor, not a causal or biological interaction effect.

continuous_ac_error_pct.description: Continuous-time resolvent error with the declared ZOH input weighting

discrete_be_error_norm_v.description: Absolute weighted discrete backward-Euler error norm

finite_dft_error_norm_v_samples.description: Absolute finite-record DFT error norm after the terminal-state correction

perturbation_transient_nrmse_pct.description: Numerically stable perturbation-coordinate finite-window transient NRMSE
